source_sha_role: latest rich-surface source baseline before release metadata refresh
source_sha_policy: Cloudflare Pages builds the governed dist artifact from main; production acceptance requires live domain, route, API and visual verification.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; duplicate URLs collapse at runtime; private, minor, legal, financial and quarantined records are excluded from the public universe.

social_corpus.policy: Person before platform; source-linked public material; metrics only with a dated source.

release_intent: Present Igor Vepretski as a living public record built from original video, long-form audio, writing, StartOn sources, research, music, social posts and clearly labeled external distribution, with source-first provenance and privacy boundaries.
promotion_gate: Promote to READY after the canonical domain serves the current rich artifact, the public feed exposes 30 curated items, critical routes pass live verification, and apex/www routing is consistent.
rollback: Prior Git commits and the last valid AppDeploy version remain available as rollback references; production routing must not use an AppDeploy catch-all proxy.
remaining_gates: Deploy the latest main-branch artifact to the existing Cloudflare Pages production project.
Verify the rich homepage, 30-item feed, Igor, Media, StartOn and Research surfaces on the canonical domain.
Verify www.7ya.io resolves to the same canonical Cloudflare Pages surface or redirects safely to 7ya.io.
